ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: At PetroChina, 98% of accounting entries are now generated automatically, yet finance hiring keeps rising. What gets cut is never the accounting role itself, but people who only know how to key in entries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 1,579,800 accountants and auditors employed in 2024, rising to a projected 1,652,600 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 72,800 jobs and about 124,200 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $81,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace accounting and auditing jobs, but it will take over much of the repetitive work. Demand for this occupation is still growing, and BLS projects 5% employment growth from 2024 to 2034. What disappears is data entry, reconciliation, and basic workpapers, not judgment, accountability, and communication.
ai_s2_accel: Full-population transaction analysis: replaces manual sampling and scans every entry for anomalies.
Fraud and risk signal detection: models catch transactions that deviate from normal patterns.
First-draft workpaper generation: large models read contracts, extract clauses, and write up notes.
Real-time risk monitoring: cash flow, credit, and compliance metrics are tracked continuously.
ai_s2_auto: Voucher recognition and OCR entry: invoices and documents are read automatically and turned into journal entries.
Bank reconciliation: the system matches transactions line by line and flags discrepancies automatically.
Invoice processing and three-way matching (purchase order, receipt, invoice).
Standardized tax filing: forms are auto-filled and validated.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and accounting policy choices. How to recognize revenue or how much to impair an asset has no single rule-based answer. AI can lay out the options, but a person makes the call.
Legal liability and signing off. Someone has to sign the audit report and answer for it when things go wrong. AI carries no liability, and regulators will not let an algorithm sign.
Professional skepticism and fraud detection. Skepticism is the core of auditing. A model can flag an anomaly, but telling an honest mistake from deliberate fraud takes experience and instinct.

Cross-functional communication and business partnering. Finance-business integration requires finance people who understand operations and can explain risk clearly. Translating analysis into business language still needs a human.

Strategic decisions and building trust. At the CFO and advisory level, trust and perspective decide outcomes. An ACCA China survey found 92% of Chinese mainland companies already use AI tools in finance, yet senior strategy conversations remain human-led (IMA/Sina, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Every occupation page here carries an AI Exposure score. It measures how much of the daily work is standardized enough for an algorithm to reproduce. Accounting scores 8/10 because its core actions, vouchers, reconciliation, and filing, happen to be highly rule-based, so AI moved in fast.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A score of 8/10 does not mean the job is about to vanish. The opposite is closer to the truth: high exposure means the occupation sits on the front line of AI change, gains efficiency first, and creates new roles first. In 2026 Chen Jun's team at Zhejiang University described a triple effect: entry-level roles shrink, digitally skilled hybrid talent emerges, and skills spread into non-accounting positions (The Paper, 2026).

ai_s5_persona.建议: Accounting is still worth studying, but study it differently: aim for CPA/CMA plus data analysis rather than bookkeeping.; 36Kr data shows AI skill requirements in accountant job postings rose from 18% in 2025 to 30% in 2026 (36Kr, 2026). To see which finance track fits you early, take the career interest and aptitude assessment.

Path A, finance business partner: demand up 69% year over year, with a 50%-100% pay premium.; Path B, senior tax or compliance specialist: cross-border tax and transfer pricing are the moat.; Path C, digital finance: master Power BI, SQL, and RPA. See what a finance business partner does.

Do not just write 'proficient in Excel.' Say how many vouchers you processed with AI and how many days you cut from the monthly close.; An Intuit 2026 survey found 88% of accountants already use AI to serve clients and 46% use it daily. Turn 'can use the tool' into 'delivered results with the tool.'

The bar shifts from accurate bookkeeping to sound interpretation, steady judgment, and willingness to be accountable.; Compare financial analysts, budget analysts, and financial managers; contrast with the high automation risk facing bookkeeping clerks. Leave basic bookkeeping to systems and screen instead for business communication and a nose for risk. For standardized screening, use the finance competency model assessment.

ai_s7_trends: First, agentic AI enters the full audit workflow. The Big Four launched agent-based audit platforms in 2025 and 2026, targeting end-to-end coverage by 2028.
Second, continuous auditing replaces the annual audit. Systems monitor in real time, so assurance shifts from a once-a-year exercise to an always-on service.
Third, AI governance auditing emerges. Companies now get audited on whether their own AI is compliant, fair, and controllable. Add ESG and data-asset assurance, and the scope of finance only widens.

method_cards.含义: 岗位数量取决于自动化节省的工时，也取决于业务增长、服务范围扩大、合规需求、人员流动和组织如何重新分配工作。BLS、WEF、ILO 与审计实证研究之所以可能得出不同结论，是因为它们分别衡量职业净就业、雇主预期、任务暴露或特定事务所的人员变化；不能用单一暴露分数直接推断会计师或审计师将被取代。

questions.回答: 以固定规则进行录入、分类、匹配、基础对账和标准申报的岗位任务暴露最高。任务高度标准化不等于岗位必然消失，实际结果还取决于组织是否完成系统接入、控制设计和业务重组。

questions.回答: 仍有职业需求，但学习重点需要从机械做账转向会计基础、数据能力、内控、法规、分析和沟通。BLS 仍预测美国会计师和审计师 2024—2034 年就业增长 5%，同时研究也提示初级任务组合将更快变化。
questions.问题: 现在学会计还有前途吗？

questions.回答: AI 可以辅助分析和起草，但不能代替具备资格和授权的注册会计师形成并承担审计意见责任。审计人员仍须验证信息、评价证据、记录复核过程并对结论负责。

That is a net gain of roughly 8,600 jobs and about 9,600 openings each year, with a 2024 median annual wage of ≥$239,200 (top BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Allergists And Immunologists, but it will accelerate administrative and testing work. AI can structure medical records, interpret reports, and search the literature, shifting physician time from organizing information toward eliciting histories, clinical judgment, and patient management. The scarce skill is connecting laboratory data to a patient's real life.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted association analysis across large allergen datasets
Digital tools for asthma and other chronic disease management
Intelligent follow-up and adjustment recommendations for allergen immunotherapy
AI-assisted recognition of skin images and rashes
ai_s2_auto: Structured entry of medical records and follow-up data
Automated generation and preliminary interpretation of allergen test reports
Intelligent search of research and guidelines
Follow-up reminders and patient registry management
ai_s3_list: History taking: an allergen can hide in one sentence from a patient, and AI does not reliably elicit such detail.
Clinical judgment: a positive test does not prove causation and must be interpreted with symptoms and real-life exposure.
Allergen immunotherapy management: treatment adjustments require long observation and a trusting relationship.
Patient education: teaching allergen avoidance and recognition of danger signs is essential to treatment.
Critical emergency judgment: AI cannot make on-site treatment decisions during anaphylaxis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means AI accelerates administrative and testing work, while the core of care, interviewing, judgment, and management, depends on clinical experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: The key to relatively low risk is specialist scarcity. AI can read reports, but specialist training is needed to determine whether findings fit the patient and how to set a treatment plan. Physician supply, not AI, is the real bottleneck.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For medical students choosing a specialty, allergy and immunology can be a strong path with many patients, few specialists, and relatively modest competition. Take residency and specialty training seriously. Long-term follow-up and patient education are valuable skills.

Use AI-assisted test interpretation and chronic disease management tools, and devote more time to complex cases and follow-up. Build your own patient follow-up system to strengthen your specialist reputation over time.

People with clinical backgrounds can enter through allergy specialty assistant or follow-up nurse roles and learn immunotherapy workflows and patient education. Becoming a specialist physician requires full clinical residency training, a long but clear path.

Allergy specialists are scarce, so recruitment should evaluate residency focus and actual case volume. AI report interpretation and follow-up systems can substantially improve clinic efficiency and patient satisfaction.

ai_s6_tools.工具: Electronic medical records and follow-up systems

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Preliminary result review and trend comparisons
Rapid guideline lookup and evidence retrieval
Rash classification and assisted differential diagnosis

ai_s6_tools.工具: Digital stethoscope and pulmonary function device

ai_s7_trends: Allergen testing and report interpretation are becoming more precise, and AI-assisted diagnosis is entering outpatient care.
Digital chronic disease management and allergen immunotherapy substantially expand follow-up reach and efficiency.
As allergic disease prevalence rises, specialist shortages persist and roles remain stable.

body: Allergists And Immunologists diagnose and treat allergic and immune system disorders, including allergic rhinitis, asthma, food and drug allergies, urticaria, and immunodeficiency. They also manage allergen immunotherapy and long-term follow-up.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能几秒钟解读一份过敏原报告，但「这位患者到底是过敏还是免疫问题、脱敏方案怎么调」，还得专科医师结合临床定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年过敏专科医师免疫学医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代过敏与免疫专科医师，但会加速案头和检测环节。病历结构化、报告解读、文献检索都能交给 AI，医师的时间从「整理资料」挪向「病史挖掘、临床判断和患者管理」。真正稀缺的，是把实验室数据和患者的真实生活对起来的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的过敏原大数据关联分析
哮喘等慢病管理的数字工具
脱敏方案的智能随访与调整建议
皮肤影像与皮疹的 AI 辅助识别
ai_s2_auto: 病历与随访数据的结构化录入
过敏原检测报告的自动生成与初读
文献与指南的智能检索
随访提醒与患者登记管理
ai_s3_list: 病史挖掘：过敏原藏在患者的一句话里，AI 问不出这种细节。
临床判断：检测阳性不等于就是病因，要结合症状和生活场景。
脱敏治疗管理：方案调整要靠长期观察和信任关系。
患者教育：教会患者规避过敏原、识别危险信号，是治疗的关键。
危重应急判断：严重过敏反应的处置，AI 给不了现场决策。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的案头和检测环节正被 AI 加速，但诊疗核心——问诊、判断、管理——依赖临床经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险的关键在于「专科稀缺」：AI 能读报告，但「报告和患者对不对得上、方案怎么定」需要专科训练。这个职业真正的瓶颈是医师供给不足，而不是 AI。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学医想走专科，过敏与免疫是不错的方向：患者多、医师少、竞争压力相对小。规培和专科培训要认真对待，长期随访和患者教育能力是加分项。
把 AI 检测解读和慢病管理工具用起来，把时间投到复杂病例和随访管理上。建立自己的患者随访体系，专科口碑会越来越厚。
医护背景可从过敏专科助理、随访护士切入，熟悉脱敏流程和患者教育。想成为专科医师必须走临床规培路径，投入周期长但路径清晰。
过敏专科人才稀缺，招聘要看规培方向和实际病例量。给医师配 AI 报告解读和随访系统，能显著提升门诊效率和患者满意度。

ai_s6_tools.工具: 哮喘/过敏慢病管理 App

ai_s7_trends: 过敏原检测与报告解读更精准，AI 辅助诊断进入门诊。
慢病管理与脱敏治疗数字化，随访半径和效率显著提升。
过敏性疾病发病率上升，专科医师缺口持续，岗位稳定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a standard course paper in minutes, but only an experienced teacher can judge whether a topic matters or how a sentence will move an audience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 35,800 Communications Teachers, Postsecondary employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 36,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with about 2,700 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $77,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Communications Teachers, Postsecondary. Classroom debate, frame-by-frame critique of student work, and training in academic reasoning depend on professional judgment and immediate feedback. AI can assist with slides, literature searches, and first-pass grading, but it cannot replace teaching and mentorship.
ai_s2_accel: AI-writing detection in academic integrity education
AI-assisted journalism and communications practice instruction
Wider adoption of interactive classroom tools
AI-assisted research topics and literature reviews
ai_s2_auto: Assistance with slides and course handouts
Automated literature searches and information organization
Automated grading of objective assignments
Automated grade summaries and teaching reports
ai_s3_list: Classroom interaction: real-time guidance during competing viewpoints.
Creative-work mentoring: feedback at the frame and sentence level.
Academic review: judgment of topic value and argument quality.
Career guidance: advice based on each student's strengths.
Values and literacy: development of media literacy and critical thinking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure tier. AI substantially improves lesson preparation, search, and first-pass grading, while teaching, research judgment, and scholarly evaluation still center on human expertise.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure requires active adaptation. Teachers who use AI in teaching and research can produce more efficiently, while those unfamiliar with it risk falling behind students and academic peers. AI is not a universal answer; teachers still review student work and scholarship.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A doctorate is usually a firm requirement for university teaching. Plan for 4 years of undergraduate study, 2-3 years for a master's degree, and 4-6 years for a doctorate. Families should expect high investment and ordinary income during the first decade, with long-term returns tied to tenure and accumulated expertise.
Use AI for lesson preparation, literature reviews, and topic screening, then invest the saved time in student mentoring and high-quality research. Digital communications is an important growth area.

Before pursuing a university role, assess whether your degrees and publication record meet the threshold. Media professionals can pursue practice-oriented faculty positions and use industry experience to strengthen teaching, but research evaluation still applies.

Do not hire communications faculty on publication counts alone. Assess whether candidates can develop students. Teachers with new-media practice, AI skills, and industry networks are scarcer and merit stronger compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AI is becoming embedded in communications education, making media literacy a required topic.
Competition for faculty positions remains intense, with research and teaching both evaluated.
Digital communications and new-media practice are becoming growth areas.

body: Communications Teachers, Postsecondary teach and conduct research in journalism, communications, public relations, and related fields. They teach theory, reporting, and media practice while guiding student creative work and scholarship.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟生成一篇标准的课程论文，但「这句话怎么说才打动人心、这个选题值不值得做」——只有教了多年书的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年传播教师在岗约 3.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.66 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.78 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代传播学教师：课堂上的观点交锋、学生作品的逐帧点评、论文写作的思维方式训练，都依赖教师的专业判断和即时反馈。AI 能帮老师做课件、查文献、批改初稿，但「育人」这件事，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 写作检测进入学术规范教育
AI 辅助新闻与传播实务教学
智能课堂互动工具普及
AI 辅助科研选题与综述写作
ai_s2_auto: 课件与讲义制作辅助
文献检索与资料整理自动化
客观题作业自动批改
成绩统计与教学报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 课堂互动：观点碰撞中的临场引导。
作品指导：具体到帧和字句的反馈。
学术把关：选题价值与论证质量的判断。
职业引路：基于学生特点的路径建议。
价值引导：媒介素养与批判思维的培养。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明高校教师处于「AI 明显改变工作方式、但替代不了核心」的位置：备课、检索、批改这些环节被 AI 大幅提效，而课堂育人、科研判断和学术共同体评价，依然围绕人的能力展开。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中分意味着要主动拥抱：会用 AI 工具辅助教学科研的教师，产出效率更高；对 AI 一无所知的教师，会同时被学生和学术竞争甩开。但别把 AI 当成万能答案，学生作品和论文的「把关人」还是你。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进高校当老师，博士学历基本是硬门槛，要做好「本科4年+硕士2-3年+博士4-6年」的长线准备。家里要有心理准备，前十年投入大、收入普通，真正回报靠的是终身教职和长期积累。
把 AI 工具用起来：AI 辅助备课、文献综述、选题筛查，省下的时间投到学生指导和高质量论文上。同时关注数字化传播方向，这是学科增长点。
想转进高校教职的，先看自己的学历和发表记录够不够门槛。传媒行业从业者转高校，可以走「双师型」教师路线，用一线经验补教学短板；但科研考核避不开。
高校招传播教师，别只看论文数量，要看「能不能把学生教出来」。懂新媒体实务、会用 AI 工具、有行业资源的高校教师更稀缺，这类人才值得给更好的待遇。

ai_s7_trends: AI 深度融入传播教学，媒介素养教育成为必修内容。
高校教职竞争持续白热化，科研与教学并重。
数字化传播与新媒介实务成为学科增长方向。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 550,300 Construction managers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 598,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 48,100 jobs. The occupation generates about 46,800 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $107,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Construction managers, but it will change how they work. BIM and AI tools are taking over scheduling, cost calculation, reports, and documentation, shifting managers from manual scheduling to digital management plus on-site command. Machines cannot replace on-site decisions, crew coordination, or safety oversight. Managers who use digital tools become more efficient.
ai_s2_accel: AI prediction of schedule-delay risk
Drone and AI vision site inspections
Adoption of smart construction-site platforms
BIM plus AI-assisted construction-plan optimization
ai_s2_auto: Digital scheduling and resource planning
Automated cost calculation and report generation
Collaborative BIM model management
Digital site monitoring and documentation
ai_s3_list: On-site decisions: schedules, weather, and emergencies require human judgment in the moment.
Crew coordination: people must manage the human dynamics of a dozen or more trades working across one another.
Safety oversight: someone must have the resolve to stop work, enforce penalties, and defend the safety baseline.
Commercial negotiation: change claims and subcontractor settlements are negotiated between people.
Overall coordination: schedule, cost, quality, and safety are inseparable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means that more than half of this occupation's management and documentation tasks are becoming digital. AI can assist with scheduling, costs, and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI is taking over parts of management, while leaving on-site command to people. On-site decisions, crew coordination, and safety oversight become even more important. Purely clerical roles face the most pressure, while managers who can control budgets, lead people, and run sites become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Civil engineering or construction management is the standard route. Prioritize site internships and professional certification. Build both technical and communication skills; a constructor qualification is a firm requirement in Chinese mainland.

Use BIM, smart construction-site platforms, and AI scheduling tools, and pursue the first-class constructor qualification. Progress from on-site management to digital management plus cost and commercial control, with the aim of becoming a project director.

Experience as a construction supervisor or technician is ideal. Start as a project production manager. On your resume, specify the scale of projects managed, the budgets controlled, and whether you delivered complete projects.

When hiring Construction managers, look beyond certificates to completed projects and cost-control ability. Managers who can control budgets, lead people, and withstand site pressure are the hardest to find.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Unified personnel and equipment management dashboard

ai_s7_trends: As BIM and smart construction sites spread, managers are shifting from manual scheduling to digital management plus on-site command, making data literacy a core skill.
Urban renewal and infrastructure gap-filling projects support long-term demand. Versatile managers who can control budgets, lead people, and run sites are increasingly sought after.
Green construction and prefabricated building are expanding, shifting managers toward hybrid roles in industrialized construction and low-carbon management.

body: Construction managers oversee on-site project execution, including construction planning, resource and crew organization, schedule and cost control, quality and safety oversight, contract and change management, and final acceptance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动排期、算成本、看监控，但工人闹情绪、班组扯皮、现场突发的那个局面，还得你到场摆平。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年施工经理在岗约 55.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 59.84 万人，净增约 4.81 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.68 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代施工经理，但会改变工作方式。进度排程、成本核算、报表文档正被 BIM 和 AI 工具接管，经理从「手工排期」转向「数字化管理+现场指挥」——现场决策、班组协调、安全把控，是机器替代不了的。会用数字化工具的经理反而更高效。
ai_s2_accel: AI 预测工期延误风险
无人机与 AI 视觉巡查现场
智慧工地平台普及
BIM+AI 辅助施工方案优化
ai_s2_auto: 进度排程与资源计划数字化
成本核算与报表自动生成
BIM 模型协同管理

ai_s3_list: 现场决策：工期、天气、突发，临场拍板靠人。
班组协调：十几个工种交叉作业，人心靠人管。
安全把控：隐患要敢停、敢罚，底线靠人守住。
商务谈判：变更索赔、分包结算，谈的是人。
全局统筹：进度、成本、质量、安全，一根绳上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有超过一半的管理文档任务正被数字化——排程、成本、报表，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「管理」环节，留下的是「指挥」环节——现场决策、班组协调和安全把控反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯文职型岗位，能管钱、管人、管现场的经理更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 土木工程、工程管理专业是正路，重视工地实习和考证。把技术和沟通都练起来，建造师证书是硬门槛。
把 BIM、智慧工地和 AI 排程工具用起来，考一级建造师。从「现场管理」升级为「数字化管理+成本经营」，往项目总监发展。
有施工员、技术员经验最好，从项目生产经理做起。简历多写「管过什么体量的项目、控过多大预算、有没有完整交付过」。
招施工经理别只看证书，要看完整项目和成本把控能力。能管钱、管人、扛得住现场压力的经理，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: BIM 与智慧工地普及，经理从「手工排期」转向「数字化管理+现场指挥」，数据素养成为基本功。
城市更新与基建补短板提供长期需求，能管钱、管人、管现场的复合经理更抢手。
绿色施工与装配式建筑推广，经理向「工业化建造+低碳管理」复合角色转变。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Algorithms can optimize routes, but people at the last mile still decide how to clear access controls, handle refusals, and prioritize urgent deliveries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 247,200 couriers and messengers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 267,600 by 2034, a net gain of about 20,400 jobs, with roughly 27,900 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $38,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace last-mile courier work, but it will reduce its premium. Systems now handle dispatch and route planning, shifting the job from finding routes independently to efficient execution, exception handling, and customer service. Pure volume-based manual work faces the most pressure. Couriers who provide good service and resolve problems have more staying power.

Automated job assignment
Automatic proof-of-delivery archiving
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: people make the call on site.
Customer communication: people handle delivery refusals.
Access coordination: people manage the relationship.
Urgent deliveries: people set priorities.
Service experience: attitude remains human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate dispatch, but people still have a role in last-mile delivery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces parts of route finding and scheduling, not the full job of completing deliveries and managing customer interactions. Couriers with strong service and exception-handling skills can become more valuable as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Entry barriers are low, but the work is demanding. Build route knowledge and service skills early instead of treating it as purely physical work.
Move from delivery volume alone toward service and exception handling, then compete for a stable, high-quality route.
Highlight your neighborhood knowledge and low complaint rate. Platforms value reliability and speed.
Do not hire on speed alone. Look for reliability and service awareness, and assign strong routes to proven team members.

ai_s7_trends: Algorithmic dispatch is spreading and reducing pay premiums.
Last-mile service matters more.
People who handle exceptions well have more job stability.

body: Couriers And Messengers provide point-to-point pickup and delivery of documents, parcels, and urgent items. They coordinate pickups, routes, and signatures, use dispatch and location tools, meet promised delivery windows, and archive proof of delivery.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Algorithms can optimize routes, but people at the last mile still decide how to clear access controls, handle refusals, and prioritize urgent deliveries.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 算法能排最优路线，但门禁怎么过、拒收怎么劝、急件怎么抢，还是末端的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年快递员在岗约 24.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 26.76 万人，净增约 2.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.79 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代快递末端，但会压低溢价。调度与路线规划交给系统，快递从「自己找路」挪向「按指令高效执行 + 异常处理 + 客户服务」。真正被挤掉的是纯体力跑量，懂服务、能处理异常的人更稳。
ai_s2_accel: 实时拥堵预测
客户画像提醒
异常自动改派
时效智能预警
ai_s2_auto: 智能路线规划
电子面单识别
自动派单
回执自动归档
ai_s3_list: 异常处理：现场靠人判。
客户沟通：拒收靠人劝。
门禁协调：关系靠人。
急件抢送：取舍靠人。
服务体验：态度靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——调度被系统加速，但末端交付还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「找路排线」动作，不是「把件送到并处理好关系」的岗位。有服务力、能处理异常的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行门槛低但要吃苦，早点练路线感和服务，别只当体力活。
从「跑量」升级成「服务 + 异常处置」，争取固定优质线路。
突出熟片区和低投诉率，平台看重稳和快。
选人别只看快，看靠谱和服务意识，骨干值得给好线路。

ai_s7_trends: 算法调度普及，溢价缩。
末端服务更被看重。
异常处理力强的人更稳。

body: 快递与信使主导文件、包裹与急件的点对点取送，统筹取件、路线与签收，运用调度与定位手段，在承诺时效内完成交付并归档回执。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 算法能排最优路线，但门禁怎么过、拒收怎么劝、急件怎么抢，还是末端的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate peak traffic at an intersection, but only a crossing guard can step forward to stop a child who runs into the road.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 91,400 Crossing Guards And Flaggers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 94,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 3,300 jobs, with roughly 18,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $37,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Crossing Guards And Flaggers, but it will change their tools. Workers once judged traffic and controlled timing entirely on their own; intelligent signals and live traffic systems now assist them, and some intersections use remote monitoring. On-site actions beside moving vehicles still require people, including holding signs, escorting pedestrians, and directing traffic with flags. Machines can calculate volume, but they cannot walk a child safely across the road.
ai_s2_accel: Traffic-sensing system: provides live flow data for decisions
Intelligent alerts: flag pedestrian violations and vehicle offenses automatically
Remote command coordination: exchanges data with traffic-police systems
Wearable warning equipment: provides intelligent visibility and location tracking
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent traffic signals: adjust timing automatically to traffic flow
Duty check-in app: digitizes scheduling, attendance, and records
Traffic monitoring system: provides remote video of priority intersections
Automated work-zone warnings: electronic signs replace some manual warning tasks
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment and response: experience guides when to use a traffic gap and how to stop a child who runs out.
Command presence: posture and confidence make drivers respond to a stop gesture.
Care for vulnerable people: older adults, children, and people with limited mobility require extra patience.
Emergency response: people decide how to handle an out-of-control vehicle or pedestrian dispute immediately.
Responsibility during long-term duty: safety cannot lapse even when guarding the same intersection every day.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score places this occupation at relatively low AI exposure because most work happens on site at intersections. AI can assist signals and records, but people still hold signs, escort pedestrians, and direct traffic with flags.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Intelligent signals and electronic warning signs absorb some fixed-pattern control, concentrating the role's value in busy periods and complex intersections. Traffic assistants and flaggers can strengthen job stability by learning to work with intelligent equipment and improving emergency response.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Education requirements are low, making this work suitable for part-time or transitional employment. Responsibility and safety awareness matter most, and traffic-safety credentials are an advantage. The role has a low technical threshold but strong resistance to replacement, suiting people who need flexible hours.

Practice emergency response and standard traffic-control signals, and earn a traffic-safety credential. Support intelligent signal equipment with human coverage during busy periods. Moving from basic guarding toward safety-management assistance strengthens job stability.

Hiring thresholds are low and training is quick. School-crossing and municipal roles are stable, while project-based construction flagging offers more variable earnings. List measurable results such as duty hours, a zero-incident record, and the number of emergencies handled.

Do not hire only for the ability to stand at a post. Evaluate responsibility and emergency response. Assistants who provide reliable long-term coverage, remain calm during incidents, and work with intelligent equipment protect safety around schools and are worth retaining.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic timing based on traffic flow
Automatic warnings that replace some manual tasks
Hand signals, flag signals, and emergency drills

ai_s7_trends: Demand for safety around schools and traffic control at construction sites remains persistent. Crossing-guard and flagger roles stay stable, often as part-time or post-retirement work.
Intelligent signals and electronic warning signs absorb fixed-pattern control, concentrating human coverage in busy periods and complex intersections.
Traffic assistants are moving from basic guarding toward safety assistance and emergency response, with higher credential and training requirements.

body: Crossing Guards And Flaggers guide pedestrians safely across roads and direct vehicles at intersections, near schools, and through construction zones. They use gestures, flag signals, and stop signs to control temporary traffic, providing highly visible on-site support within the traffic-safety system.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate peak traffic at an intersection, but only a crossing guard can step forward to stop a child who runs into the road.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出路口车流高峰，但孩子跑到马路中间那一刻，冲上去挡住的只能是路口警卫。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年交通路口警卫旗手在岗约 9.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.47 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.80 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代交通路口警卫和旗手，但会改变「辅助工具」。以前全靠人判断车流、控制节奏，现在有智能信号灯、实时路况系统辅助，部分路口还可以远程监控。可站在车流边上的现场动作——举牌、带人过街、旗语指挥，还得靠人——机器能算流量，但不替你把孩子安全送过马路。
ai_s2_accel: 车流感知系统：实时流量数据辅助判断
智能预警：行人闯灯、车辆违章自动提醒
远程指挥联动：与交警系统数据互通
穿戴式警示装备：智能反光与定位
ai_s2_auto: 智能信号灯：按车流自动调节配时
执勤签到 App：排班、打卡、记录电子化
路况监控系统：重点路口远程视频查看
施工围挡警示自动化：电子警示牌替代部分人工
ai_s3_list: 现场判断与反应：车流间隙怎么把握、孩子冲出来怎么拦，靠经验。
指挥的权威感：一个手势让司机停下来，靠的是姿态和自信。
对弱势群体的照顾：老人、孩子、行动不便者，要格外耐心。
突发情况的应急：车辆失控、行人争执，第一时间怎么处置。
长期值守的责任心：天天站同一个路口，安全一天都不能松。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业绝大多数工作在现场、在路口——AI 能辅助信号和记录，但举牌、带人过街、旗语指挥这些现场动作，还远没到能被机器替代的程度。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低曝光不等于没变化。智能信号灯和电子警示牌正在分担一部分「固定模式」的管控，岗位价值越来越集中在「重点时段、复杂路口的人防」上。对交通协管员和旗手来说，学会配合智能设备、提升应急能力，反而让岗位更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，适合作为兼职或过渡岗位。重点是责任心和安全意识，交通安全类证书加分。AI 时代，这行技术门槛低但不可替代性强，适合需要灵活时间的人。
把应急能力、指挥规范练扎实，考个交通安全员证书。配合智能信号设备做好重点时段人防，从「单纯值守」往「安全管理辅助」走，岗位更稳。
招聘门槛低、上手快，学校门口或市政岗位稳定，施工旗手项目制收入弹性大。简历上写「值守时长、零事故记录、处理突发次数」这类可量化成果。
招人别只看「能站岗」，要看责任心和应急反应。能长期稳定值守、处理突发冷静、配合智能设备的协管员，是学校周边安全的可靠保障，值得留。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动警示、替代部分人工

ai_s7_trends: 学校周边安全与施工交通管理需求长期存在，路口警卫与旗手岗位稳定，更多作为兼职和返聘岗位存在。
智能信号灯、电子警示牌分担固定模式的管控，岗位价值向重点时段、复杂路口的人防集中。
协管员角色从「单纯值守」向「安全辅助 + 应急响应」升级，持证与培训要求提高。

body: 交通路口警卫与旗手负责在道路路口、学校周边和施工路段引导行人安全过街、指挥车辆通行，使用手势、旗语和停牌管控临时交通，是交通安全体系中现场性最强的辅助岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can spot a cavity on an image immediately, but a dentist must decide whether to save or extract the tooth and whether to place a filling or perform a root canal. That judgment accounts for symptoms, daily life, and cost, and the procedure still requires a skilled hand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 129,800 Dentists, General were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 135,200 by 2034. That represents about 5,400 new jobs and roughly 3,900 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $172,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dentists, General, but it will change how they work. AI image analysis quickly flags cavities and periodontal problems, while digital treatment and record systems are spreading. Dentists can spend less time reviewing images and more time choosing treatments and performing procedures. Clinical judgment, precision technique, and patient trust remain human strengths.
ai_s2_accel: AI assists root-canal localization and implant planning
CAD/CAM digital restoration becomes more common
Automated tooth arrangement and clear-aligner planning
Telehealth and remote image consultation expand
ai_s2_auto: AI image analysis identifies cavities and periodontal lesions
Digital records and appointment systems
Intraoral scanning replaces traditional impressions
Automated archiving and analysis of diagnostic images
ai_s3_list: Clinical treatment judgment: deciding whether to save or extract a tooth based on symptoms and daily life.
Tactile precision: fillings and root canals depend on practiced hands.
Patient communication and trust: patients accept treatment when the dentist explains the plan clearly.
Emergency response: calmly managing anesthetic reactions or bleeding during a procedure.
Professional ethics and accountability: every decision about a tooth can affect a patient for life.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Dentists, General in the moderate AI exposure range. Digital tools increasingly assist image review, records, and impressions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI assists diagnosis, while dentists retain treatment procedures, clinical judgment, and patient trust. Pure image-reading support roles face more pressure, making the core value of general dentists more visible.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Dental education requires tolerance for long training and high cost. It suits students with strong grades, steady hands, attention to detail, and the ability to invest for years. Specialization in orthodontics or implant dentistry is one path.
Learn AI image analysis, digital restoration, and implant techniques, then build a specialty focus. Deeper skill in orthodontics, implant dentistry, or another area can raise earning potential.

A career change into dentistry requires recognized education and licensing examinations; there is no shortcut. Adjacent roles such as Dental assistants or Dental Laboratory Technicians offer other entry points into oral health care.
Do not assess dentists by education alone. Evaluate manual skill and patient reputation, and give early-career dentists training on digital equipment to improve efficiency and service quality.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Three-dimensional imaging of alveolar bone and root canals
Automatically marks cavities and periodontal disease
Designs and fabricates crowns on the same day

ai_s7_trends: As AI image analysis and digital restoration spread, dentists shift from reading images toward treatment decisions and precision procedures. Digital skill becomes standard.
Greater oral-health awareness and population aging increase demand. Dentists specializing in implant care, orthodontics, or pediatric care are especially sought after.
Dental chains and teleconsultation are expanding. Dentists increasingly combine clinical care, operations, and digital skills, while independent practice becomes harder to enter.

body: Dentists, General examine, diagnose, and treat oral disease. They repair cavities, treat periodontal disease, perform root canals and extractions, clean teeth, and provide oral-health education as general practitioners in the oral-care system.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can spot a cavity on an image immediately, but a dentist must decide whether to save or extract the tooth and whether to place a filling or perform a root canal. That judgment accounts for symptoms, daily life, and cost, and the procedure still requires a skilled hand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一眼看出片子上的蛀牙，但「这颗牙保还是拔、补还是根管」——结合症状、生活和费用的判断，加上亲手操作的准头，还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年普通牙医职业诊断在岗约 12.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.52 万人，净增约 0.54 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 17.28 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代普通牙医，但会改变工作方式。AI 读片能快速标出龋齿和牙周问题，数字化诊疗和病历系统在普及，牙医从「看片子」里解放出来，把精力放到治疗方案和亲手操作上。治疗方案判断、精细操作和患者信任，是 AI 替代不了的核心。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助根管定位与种植规划
CAD/CAM 数字化修复普及
智能排牙与隐形正畸方案
远程问诊与影像会诊推广
ai_s2_auto: AI 读片识别龋齿与牙周病变
数字化病历与预约系统
口腔扫描替代传统取模
诊疗影像自动归档分析
ai_s3_list: 治疗方案的临床判断：保还是拔，要综合症状与生活。
精细操作的手感：补牙、根管，靠的是手上功夫。
患者沟通与信任：方案讲明白，患者才敢把牙交给你。
突发状况的处置：麻药过敏、术中出血，冷静处理。
职业伦理与责任：每一颗牙的决定都关乎患者一生。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的辅助环节正在被数字化——读片、病历、取模，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「诊断辅助」环节，治疗操作、方案判断和患者信任依然靠医生。真正被压缩的是纯影像判读的辅助岗，全科牙医的核心价值反而更突出。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选口腔医学要耐得住长学制和高成本。适合手稳心细、成绩好、能长期投入的孩子，专科化（正畸、种植）是方向。
把 AI 读片、数字化修复和种植技术学起来，主动专科化。从全科向正畸、种植等方向精进，收入差距明显。
转行做牙医必须走正规学历和执业考试，没有捷径。也可以考虑牙科助理、技师等外围岗位切入。
招牙医别只看学历，要看动手能力和患者口碑。给年轻医生数字化设备培训，能提升诊所效率和服务质量。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 牙槽骨与根管三维成像

ai_s7_trends: AI 读片与数字化修复普及，牙医从「看片子」转向「方案判断+精细操作」，数字化技能成为标配。
口腔健康意识提升与老龄化带动需求增长，专科化（种植、正畸、儿牙）的牙医更抢手。
连锁诊所与远程会诊扩张，牙医向「医疗+运营+数字化」复合角色转变，独立执业门槛提高。

body: 普通牙医负责口腔疾病的检查、诊断与治疗，包括龋齿修补、牙周治疗、根管治疗、拔牙与洁牙，并开展口腔健康宣教，是口腔医疗服务体系中的全科医生角色。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can process a week's worth of literature in a second, but economists still decide whether a question is worth asking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 17,600 Economists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 17,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 900 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $115,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace economists, but it will reshape their research workflow. Once AI handles literature searches, data cleaning, and preliminary modeling, researchers can shift from running regressions to framing questions, specifying models, and making policy judgments. The truly scarce skill is the ability to ask good questions and identify causality in ambiguous economic phenomena.
ai_s2_accel: Large language model assistance with research hypotheses and literature reviews
Rapid literature reviews of policy effects
Automated iteration of scenario simulations
Automated translation of multilingual economic materials
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent search and summarization of economic literature and policy
Automated cleaning of macroeconomic and microeconomic data
Preliminary modeling for routine econometrics and forecasting
Automated management of references and data
ai_s3_list: Research design: deciding which questions are worth asking.
Model specification: choosing variables and identification strategies.
Policy judgment: turning evidence into decisions.
Cross-domain synthesis: integrating economics, politics, and history.
Public communication: explaining models to the public.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for text and data work. Search, cleaning, and preliminary modeling can all be accelerated, but people still frame questions and exercise judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces searching and routine model runs, not thinking and judgment. Economists who can frame questions and make policy judgments become scarcer. Entry-level research assistants limited to moving data face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in economics and mathematics, and learn programming and econometrics early. In the AI era, research design and policy judgment matter more than memorizing theory.
Become proficient with AI literature and modeling tools, and strengthen policy and communication skills. Move from writing papers to providing advice to broaden your opportunities.
Highlight the research you have completed and the audiences for whom you have produced forecasts. Quantitative methods and demonstrated policy impact are advantages.
Assess candidates' ability to identify problems and translate research into policy, not just their academic credentials. Researchers who can independently produce briefs merit premium compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Demand remains steady for policy research and financial regulatory analysis.
As AI literature and modeling tools spread, entry-level search roles are contracting.
Professionals who combine quantitative expertise with policy translation are becoming scarcer.

body: Economists study resource allocation, production and consumption, inflation and employment, and public policy. They use econometric and macroeconomic models to analyze data and produce research and policy recommendations at universities, think tanks, central banks, and financial institutions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can process a week's worth of literature in a second, but economists still decide whether a question is worth asking.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一秒里跑完你一周的文献，但「这个问题值不值得问」，还得经济学家拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年经济学家在岗约 1.76 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.78 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.54 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代经济学家，但会重构研究流程。文献检索、数据清洗和初步建模交给 AI 后，学者从「跑回归」挪向「提问题、设模型、做政策判断」。真正稀缺的是能提出好问题、在模糊经济现象里找因果的人。
ai_s2_accel: 大模型辅助生成研究假设与综述
政策效果的快速文献综览
情景模拟的自动迭代
多语种经济资料的自动翻译
ai_s2_auto: 经济文献与政策的智能检索摘要
宏观微观数据的自动清洗
常规计量与预测的初步建模
参考文献与数据的自动管理
ai_s3_list: 研究设计：什么问题值得问。
模型设定：变量和识别怎么选。
政策判断：证据怎么落决策。
跨域综合：把经济政治历史拧一起。
公共沟通：把模型讲给公众。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文本与数据区——检索、清洗、初模都能被加速，但提问和判断仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「查和跑」，不是「想和判」。会提问题、能做政策判断的经济学家更稀缺。怕的是只做数据搬运的初级研究助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 经济数学打底，早学编程与计量。AI 时代拼研究设计与政策判断，别只背理论。
把 AI 文献和建模工具用熟，补政策与沟通。从「写论文」升级成「做咨询」，路更宽。
突出你做过什么研究、给谁做过预测。有量化方法和政策成果优先。
招人看问题意识和政策转化力，不止看学历。能独立出简报的研究员值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 政策研究与金融监管分析需求稳。
AI 文献与建模工具普及，初级检索岗压缩。
会量化又会政策转化的复合学者更稀缺。

body: 经济学家（Economists）研究资源分配、生产消费、通胀就业与公共政策，运用计量与宏观模型分析数据，在高校、智库、央行和金融机构产出研究与政策建议。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can use a fault code to identify a failed circuit board, but a multimeter and field experience are still needed to find a loose terminal, faded wire color, or altered PLC program.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 7,000 electrical and electronics installers and repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 7,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $82,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace electrical and electronics installers and repairers, but it will take over parts of fault diagnosis, manual searches, and maintenance records. Lockout work, on-site measurement, disassembly, and component replacement still require practical field skills that machines cannot replace soon.
ai_s2_accel: Predictive maintenance systems that warn of faults early
Infrared thermography and acoustic detection for fault location
AR glasses that overlay wiring diagrams
Remote diagnostic platforms connected to manufacturer support
ai_s2_auto: AI-generated diagnostic guidance from fault codes
Digital searches of manuals and schematics
Automated generation of maintenance records and logs
AI forecasting and replenishment of spare-parts inventory
ai_s3_list: Field diagnosis: never trust an alarm code without verifying the actual fault through measurement.
Electrical safety: lock out, verify de-energization, and tag the equipment without skipping any step.
Wiring and replacement skill: accurate terminal crimping and component installation depend on trained hands.
Automation-system knowledge: technicians who understand PLC programs and communication parameters repair equipment faster.
Production-line coordination: every minute of downtime costs money, so rapid restoration matters.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means moderate AI exposure. Diagnosis, information retrieval, and recordkeeping account for a meaningful share of the work and increasingly use AI. Field service and safe electrical work remain human-led, which limits replacement potential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean unemployment. AI can accelerate diagnosis, but people must complete the repair correctly. Workers limited to simple part replacement face pressure, while those skilled in PLCs and predictive maintenance gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study electrical automation or mechatronics and obtain the required electrician credential. Learn PLCs, variable-frequency drives, and communication protocols, not just wiring. As equipment becomes smarter, demand grows for people who can repair it.

Learn PLC programming, variable-frequency drive commissioning, and predictive maintenance. Progress from repairing equipment quickly to preventing failures. Advanced electrician or technician credentials can support a move into equipment management or electrical engineering.

Career changers with electrical fundamentals should earn the required credential before entering through an apprentice or electrician role. On a resume, evidence such as independently resolving a specific equipment fault with no recurrence is more useful than a list of tools.

Test maintenance candidates on safety procedures before technical skills. Do not hire anyone who neglects lockout and tagging. Prioritize PLC and predictive-maintenance skills because they can reduce downtime even though these candidates are harder to find.

ai_s7_trends: As predictive maintenance spreads, repairers move from fixing failures to preventing them.
As equipment becomes smarter, repairers with PLC, communications, and automation commissioning skills become more valuable.
As AI diagnostics enter the field, repairers shift from troubleshooting alone to verifying diagnoses and completing on-site work.

body: Electrical And Electronics Installers And Repairers install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic equipment such as industrial control cabinets, motors, variable-frequency drives, and circuit boards. They use measurements to locate faults and replace components to restore operation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can use a fault code to identify a failed circuit board, but a multimeter and field experience are still needed to find a loose terminal, faded wire color, or altered PLC program.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能根据故障代码直接告诉你哪块板子坏了，但现场的端子松没松、接线颜色褪没褪、PLC 程序是不是被改过，还得靠你的万用表和经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电气与电子设备安装维修人员在岗约 0.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.74 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电气设备维修人员，但会接管故障诊断、说明书查询和维修记录。剩下的断电作业、现场测量、拆装更换，是实打实的现场功夫，机器短期替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 预测性维护系统提前预警故障
红外热像与声学检测辅助定位
AR 眼镜叠加接线图纸
远程诊断平台联动厂家支持
ai_s2_auto: AI 故障代码自动诊断提示
说明书与图纸电子化查询
维修记录与台账自动生成
备件库存 AI 预测补货
ai_s3_list: 现场诊断：报警代码不全信，真实故障要靠测量验证。
电气安全执行：断电、验电、挂牌，一步都不能省。
接线与更换手感：端子压接、元器件拆装，是手上的准头。
自动化系统理解：PLC 程序、通信参数，看得懂才能修得快。
与产线的配合：停机每一分钟都是钱，怎么快速恢复生产。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的诊断、查询、记录比重不低，这些正被 AI 辅助；但现场作业与安全操作是人的主战场，AI 替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高风险不等于失业。AI 帮你「诊断得快」，但你得「修得对」——诊断交给 AI，动手还得靠人。真正被挤压的是不会自动化设备、只做简单换件的电工；懂 PLC、会预测性维护的人反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选电气自动化或机电一体化专业，把电工证考到手。AI 时代别只学接线，把 PLC、变频器、通信协议学起来——未来设备越智能，会修智能设备的人越缺。
主动学 PLC 编程、变频器调试和预测性维护，把「修得快」升级成「让设备不坏」。考高级电工、技师证书，往设备管理或电气工程师方向走。
有电气基础想转行，先考证再入行，从维修学徒或电工做起。简历写「独立处理过XX类设备故障、修复后零复发」这类成果，比罗列工具名有用。
招维修工先考安全规程再考技术——断电挂牌都不讲究的不能要。优先招懂 PLC 与预测性维护的人，虽然难招，但能帮你把停机损失降到最低。

ai_s7_trends: 预测性维护普及，维修工从「坏了再修」转向「让设备不坏」。
设备智能化加深，会 PLC、通信与自动化调试的维修工吃香。
AI 诊断进现场，维修工角色从「排故员」转向「诊断验证与现场执行人」。

body: 电气与电子设备安装维修人员负责各类电气与电子设备（工业控制柜、电机、变频器、电子板卡等）的安装、调试、保养与故障排除，通过测量定位与更换修复使设备恢复正常运。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify structures in massive seismic datasets, but people still make the scientific judgment about whether a site is worth drilling and whether the data hides serious pitfalls.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 25,100 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 26,000 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 900 jobs, with roughly 2,000 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $99,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Geoscientists, but it will change research methods. AI greatly accelerates seismic processing, lithology recognition, and numerical modeling, reducing roles centered on manual interpretation. Scientists shift toward formulating questions, designing investigations, integrating evidence, and judging risk. The energy transition is also creating a broader range of research directions.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted reservoir identification and prediction
Remote-sensing and drone geological surveys
Machine-learning prediction of geological hazards
Modeling for carbon storage and geothermal assessment
ai_s2_auto: Automatic processing of seismic and well-log data
Lithology recognition and map generation
Digital field records and databases
Batch numerical simulation
ai_s3_list: Scientific questions: identify Earth problems worth studying.
Integrated interpretation: turn multi-source data into a credible conclusion.
Field judgment: recognize real conditions in outcrops and sections.
Risk decisions: make judgments with incomplete data.
Cross-disciplinary collaboration: work with engineering, environmental, and climate teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. Seismic, well-log, and remote-sensing work involves massive datasets that AI processes far faster than people. Scientific interpretation still depends on domain experience and creative reasoning, while fieldwork and decisions remain less automated, keeping the score at 6.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Use AI as a magnifying glass. Machine learning can process data and modeling software can test scenarios, leaving more time for scientific judgment and field investigation. Geoscientists with programming and AI skills have a clear competitive advantage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Prepare for graduate education in earth science. An undergraduate degree is often only the starting point, while master's and doctoral degrees are common. Build strong mathematics, physics, and programming foundations because AI and modeling skills increasingly matter more than memorization.

Develop programming and machine-learning skills. Data processing and modeling are industry trends, and AI-proficient scientists deliver greater output. Energy-transition minerals, geothermal energy, and carbon storage offer broad transfer opportunities.
People with geology, physics, or computer science backgrounds can transition. Emphasize data processing and modeling in interviews, while field capability and project experience are advantages.

Geoscientists are scarce, and retention depends on research opportunities and support for advanced study. Research-oriented employees often value access to oil and gas institutes or geological survey training more than salary increases alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Seismic section interpretation and structural analysis
Basin evolution and hydrocarbon accumulation simulation

ai_s7_trends: The energy transition creates new directions in critical minerals, geothermal energy, and carbon storage.
AI and machine learning are becoming standard tools for data processing and interpretation.
Demand is rising for cross-disciplinary work spanning earth, environmental, and climate science.

body: Geoscientists, Except Hydrologists And Geographers study Earth's composition, internal structure, and evolutionary history. They use field surveys, laboratory analysis, and numerical simulation to address energy exploration and geological hazard prevention.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify structures in massive seismic datasets, but people still make the scientific judgment about whether a site is worth drilling and whether the data hides serious pitfalls.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从海量地震数据里自动圈出构造，但「这块地到底值不值得钻探、数据里是不是藏着陷阱」——科学判断还得靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年地球科学家（不含水文学家与地理学家）在岗约 2.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.60 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代地球科学家，但会改变研究方式：地震数据处理、岩性识别、数值建模这些环节被 AI 大幅加速，纯手工解释的岗位在减少；科学家把精力转向提出科学问题、设计调查方案、综合解释和风险判断——这些能力 AI 替代不了。能源转型也带来新课题，方向比以往更宽。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助油气藏识别与预测
遥感与无人机地质调查
机器学习地质灾害预测
碳封存与地热评估建模
ai_s2_auto: 地震与测井数据自动处理
岩性识别与图件生成
野外记录与数据库电子化
数值模拟批量运算
ai_s3_list: 科学问题：找到值得研究的地球难题。
综合解释：把多源数据讲成一个可信结论。
野外判断：在露头和剖面上看出现场真相。
风险决策：数据不全时敢下判断。
跨学科协作：与工程、环境、气候团队配合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明地球科学的「数据面」已经深度 AI 化：地震、测井、遥感都是海量数据，AI 处理效率远超人工；但科学解释依赖领域经验和创造性思维，野外与决策环节自动化程度低，所以是 6 分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 AI 当「放大镜」：用机器学习处理数据、用建模软件做方案，省下时间做科学判断和野外调查；会编程、懂 AI 的地球科学家，在行业里明显更有竞争力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走地球科学要做好读研准备：本科只是起点，硕士博士是主流；把数学、物理和编程学扎实，未来 AI 和建模能力比背知识点更值钱。
补上编程和机器学习：数据处理和建模是行业趋势，会 AI 的科学家产能更高；关注新能源矿产、地热、碳封存方向，转岗空间大。
有地质、物理、计算机背景的人可以转；面试时突出「数据处理+建模」能力，能跑野外、有项目经历是加分项。
地球科学家稀缺，留人靠「项目空间+深造支持」；把博士送往油气研究院、地调机构深造，比单纯加薪更能留住研究型人才。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 地震剖面解释与构造分析

ai_s7_trends: 能源转型带来新能源矿产、地热与碳封存新方向。
AI 与机器学习成为数据处理解释的标配。
多学科交叉（地球+环境+气候）需求上升。

body: 地球科学家（不含水文学家与地理学家）是地球科学家研究地球的物质组成、内部结构与演化历史，通过野外调查、实验分析和数值模拟，解决能源资源勘探、地质灾害防治。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb many repetitive and structured tasks in hazardous materials removal, but people still carry judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination. Pure execution roles face the greatest pressure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 51,300 hazardous materials removal workers in 2024, projected to rise to 51,800 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 500 jobs, with roughly 5,000 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $48,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace hazardous materials removal workers, but it will reshape their workflow. Tools take repetitive and structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creative problem-solving. Workers who only follow scripts face pressure, while those who adapt to real conditions and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate assessment of hazardous-materials clients or trainees.
Use simulations and exercises to accelerate hazardous-materials response planning.
Use retrieval tools to verify hazardous-materials information and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in hazardous-materials work.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured hazardous-materials documents and reports.
Process and classify repetitive hazardous-materials data.
Perform rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for hazardous-materials work.
Search hazardous-materials knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real hazardous-materials settings.
The ability to explain hazardous-materials expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in hazardous-materials work.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination for hazardous-materials work.
Reuse of tacit knowledge built through long hazardous-materials experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. AI can assist hazardous-materials work, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 5/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: First build strong hazardous-materials fundamentals and gain real project experience.
Connect existing experience to hazardous-materials work and find a differentiated entry point.
Turn hazardous-materials experience into products or management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive hazardous-materials work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between hazardous-materials workers and AI becomes normal, making tool fluency an entry requirement.
Second, high-value judgment and accountability in hazardous-materials work become scarcer.
Third, hazardous-materials roles evolve toward combined professional and management or product skills.

body: Hazardous Materials Removal Workers wear protective equipment to handle asbestos, lead, chemicals, and spills. They package, transport, and neutralize hazardous waste according to procedures, protecting people and the environment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb many repetitive and structured tasks in hazardous materials removal, but people still carry judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination. Pure execution roles face the greatest pressure.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代危险材料清除工适合谁？，但会重塑Hazardous materials removal workers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。

用检索增强Hazardous materials removal workers的资料与法规查证。

把Hazardous materials removal workers专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Hazardous materials removal workers领域的责任承担与终审。

Emergency response: staying calm while disconnecting units, reducing load, and isolating faults within seconds according to contingency plans takes practice.
On-site maintenance coordination: every safety isolation step for taking equipment out of and returning it to service must be correct.
Communication and coordination with dispatch: understanding instructions and clearly reporting operating conditions is the interface that safeguards the power supply.
Understanding the entire system: from boiler to turbine to grid, operators need a whole-system view of how one change affects everything.

Treat AI forecasting and equipment-diagnostic systems as partners, and learn the logic behind the data. Advance toward shift supervisor or technical specialist roles, while watching opportunities in renewable energy and storage plants instead of remaining confined to conventional thermal power.

People with electrical, mechanical, or chemical backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. Start as an inspector or assistant operator, earn operating credentials, and describe experience such as participating in XX startups, shutdowns, or emergency responses on your resume.

When hiring operations staff, evaluate emergency composure before education. A simulated incident reveals capability best. People who operate equipment, understand systems, and lead shifts are the core staff power plants should retain.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工具能标拼写，但语境怎么判、作者意图怎么保、专业规范怎么守，还是校对定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年校对与文稿标记员在岗约 1.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.19 万人，岗位净减约 0.01 万个，年均产生约 0.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代校对与文稿标记员，但会接管基础校对。拼写与版式检查把常规错字提速，校对从「挑错字」挪向「语境把关、专业规范、作者沟通」。真正被挤掉的是纯挑字，懂规范、能判断的人更稳。
ai_s2_accel: 语境智能判断
风格智能建议
改定自动标注
质量趋势预警
ai_s2_auto: 拼写自动检查
版式自动校验
数字一致性检查
专名库比对
ai_s3_list: 语境把关：歧义靠人判。
专业规范：标准靠人守。
作者沟通：取舍靠人。
复杂文本：结构靠人。
质量兜底：零差错靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「挑基础错字」动作，不是「语境与专业把关」的岗位。有规范力、能判断的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会挑错字的校对。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中文/新闻起步多练规范和细心，AI 时代纯挑字在缩，早点练把关。
从「挑错」升级成「规范 + 沟通」，学专业领域用语。
突出零差错与专业领域，出版社看重稳和准。
选人别只看快，看规范意识和耐心，骨干值得给重点稿。

ai_s7_trends: 工具普及，基础活缩。
专业把关带来机会。
能判断的校对更稳。

body: 校对与文稿标记员主导文稿的核对与标记，统筹文字、标点与版式，运用规范与工具手段，发现并标注差错，保障内容质量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 工具能标拼写，但语境怎么判、作者意图怎么保、专业规范怎么守，还是校对定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can write a press release in one minute, but PR professionals must use experience and intuition to judge how the media will report a sentence and how the public will interpret it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 315,900 public relations specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 331,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 15,100 jobs, with about 27,600 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $69,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace public relations specialists, but it will reduce writer-only roles. Tools are taking over first drafts of press releases, media lists, public sentiment monitoring, and event copy. The real value lies in strategic judgment, media relations, and crisis response. PR is a business of trust between people: journalists cover your story only when they trust you, and executives let you speak during a crisis only when they trust your judgment.
ai_s2_accel: AI sentiment analysis warning of public opinion risks
Intelligent distribution platforms expanding reach
KOL matching and data evaluation tools
Real-time communication performance dashboards
ai_s2_auto: First-draft generation for press releases and official statements
Automated media lists and placement
Automated public sentiment monitoring and summaries
Rapid production of event copy and materials
ai_s3_list: Media relations: making journalists willing to support your story at critical moments.
Crisis judgment: knowing what to address and when to remain silent.
Strategic balance: finding the right communication position among stakeholders.
On-site adaptability: handling unexpected situations at press conferences.
Trusted advice: executives and clients listen to your recommendations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 means AI is heavily reshaping PR content and data work. Press releases, copy, monitoring, and distribution can all be automated. But the decision layer of PR, including strategy, relationships, and crises, depends heavily on human judgment and credibility. AI devalues writing alone and raises the value of thinking and interpersonal skill.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is an industry shakeup. AI makes standard press releases less valuable but makes PR professionals who put out fires and bring resources more valuable. Use the time saved on writing to cultivate media relationships and practice crisis decisions, and your value can rise as AI spreads.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Journalism and communications is a good entry route, but internships are essential for experiencing the actual pace. PR is not simply writing articles; revisions, blame, and overtime are routine. It suits strong writers who handle pressure and enjoy working with people.

Use AI tools to save writing time and focus on media relationships and crisis management. Advance toward integrated marketing and brand strategy rather than remaining a writer, the role AI will replace first.

People with journalism, new media, or marketing backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. Learn case-based PR thinking and create several communication projects. In interviews, explain what campaigns you planned and what public sentiment issues you handled rather than discussing theory.

When hiring PR staff, stop testing only writing and emphasize public sentiment judgment and crisis adaptability, including simulated crisis scenarios. AI tools can reduce costs, but core roles should go to people with media resources and sound judgment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid generation of first-draft press releases
Web-wide media volume and sentiment monitoring
Early warning of negative public sentiment
Press conference workflows and guest management

ai_s7_trends: As AI takes over press releases and monitoring, PR increasingly centers on strategy, relationships, and crisis management.
As content becomes more fragmented, brand communication depends more on people who tell stories and choose channels effectively.
Media resources + crisis judgment become the core advantage for PR professionals.

body: Public relations specialists manage communication between organizations, the public, and the media. Through press releases, media relations, event planning, and public sentiment management, they shape and protect brand image and serve as a key communication link between an organization and the outside world.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can write a press release in one minute, but PR professionals must use experience and intuition to judge how the media will report a sentence and how the public will interpret it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟写完通稿，但「这句话发出去媒体会怎么报道、公众会怎么解读」——这个判断，得公关拿经验和直觉来扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公共关系专员在岗约 31.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 33.10 万人，净增约 1.51 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.76 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.98 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代公关专员，但会压缩「写手型」岗位：新闻稿初稿、媒体列表、舆情监测、活动文案都被工具接管。真正的价值在策略判断、媒体关系和危机应对——公关是「人跟人的信任生意」，记者信你才会报你的稿，危机时老板信你才敢让你发话。
ai_s2_accel: AI 情绪分析预警舆情风险
智能分发平台扩大传播触达
KOL 匹配与数据评估工具
传播效果实时数据看板
ai_s2_auto: 新闻稿与通稿初稿生成
媒体列表与投放自动化
舆情监测与摘要自动生成
活动文案与物料快速产出
ai_s3_list: 媒体关系：让记者在关键时候愿意帮你说话。
危机判断：知道什么该回应、什么该沉默。
策略拿捏：在不同利益方之间找到传播平衡。
现场应变：发布会上突发状况的临场处置。
信任背书：你给的建议，老板和客户听得进去。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明公关的「内容与数据层」正被 AI 重度重构：通稿、文案、监测、分发都能自动化。但公关的决策层——策略、关系、危机——高度依赖人的判断和信誉，AI 让「会写」贬值，让「会想、会来事」升值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是行业洗牌：AI 把通稿变得不值钱，但把「能救火、能带资源」的公关变得更值钱。把时间从写稿里省出来，多经营媒体关系、多练危机决策，你的价值会随 AI 普及反向上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 新闻传播专业是好入口，但建议孩子提前实习感受真实节奏——公关不是「写写文章」那么简单，改稿、背锅、加班都是常态。有抗压能力、爱跟人打交道、文字功底好的孩子更适合。
把 AI 工具用起来省掉写稿时间，把精力放到媒体关系经营和危机管理上。往整合营销和品牌策略方向升级，别停在「写手」层——那是 AI 最先替代的位置。
有记者、新媒体、市场营销背景的人转型有优势。先补公关案例思维，做几个传播作品；面试时重点讲「你策划过什么传播、处理过什么舆情」，比讲理论有用。
招公关别再只考写作，重点考察舆情判断和危机应变——可以用模拟危机情景题。AI 工具能降本，但核心岗位要留给有媒体资源和判断力的人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 发布会流程与嘉宾管理

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管通稿与监测，公关重心向策略、关系与危机管理集中。
内容碎片化加剧，品牌传播更依赖「会讲故事、会选渠道」的人。
「媒体资源 + 危机判断」成为公关从业者的核心护城河。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Online tools can instantly calculate power generation and payback, but representatives still determine whether homeowners trust the proposal, whether the roof can support installation, and how to turn the conversation into a signed contract.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 303,200 sales representatives and assessors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 308,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,700 jobs, with about 27,200 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $100,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace solar sales, but it will accelerate calculations and system configuration. Power generation simulations, proposal generation, and quotes speed up the early stages, shifting representatives from calculations toward building trust in person, conducting site surveys, negotiating contracts, and following through on installation. Calculations become faster, while people who can travel to sites and negotiate become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted shading assessment
Faster policy matching
Customer profile recommendations
Faster follow-up reminders
ai_s2_auto: Automatically calculate power generation
Automatically generate system configurations
Automatically generate quotes
Automatically calculate the payback period
ai_s3_list: In-person trust: people determine whom homeowners trust.
Site assessment: people determine whether installation is feasible.
Negotiation and contracting: people determine how to make the case.
Installation follow-through: people ensure implementation.
Handling objections: people resolve hesitation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderately high exposure in the calculation side of the occupation. Early calculations and configurations are accelerated, but people retain an essential role in site visits and negotiations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean replacement. What gets replaced is calculating figures and producing configurations, not roles that build trust and secure contracts. People who can work in the field and negotiate become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only recite quotes face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a relevant associate degree and study solar technology and policy while in school. Pure calculation work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop communication and site-assessment skills early.
Advance from reciting quotes to building trust plus ensuring implementation. Learn simulation tools and seek promotion to regional manager.
Highlight actual sales volume and site-assessment experience, clearly describing the regions you have covered. Employers value people who can work in the field and close deals.
When hiring, look beyond sales talk and assess whether candidates conduct accurate site surveys. People who can deliver projects deserve high commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation tools raise productivity and reduce calculation work.
Demand for distributed solar increases.
People who can work in the field and secure contracts are in greater demand.

body: Solar sales representatives and assessors visit properties to evaluate roof orientation and shading, calculate power generation and investment returns, explain incentives and grid-connection policies, develop and negotiate solar system proposals, and move contracts and installations through completion.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Online tools can instantly calculate power generation and payback, but representatives still determine whether homeowners trust the proposal, whether the roof can support installation, and how to turn the conversation into a signed contract.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 线上工具能秒算发电和回本，但这户信不信、屋顶能不能装、话怎么讲到签，还是代表定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年销售代表评估员在岗约 30.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 30.89 万人，净增约 0.57 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.72 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代光伏销售，但会加速测算与配置。发电模拟、方案生成和报价把前期提速，代表从「算数」挪向「上门信任、现场勘测、谈判签约、安装跟进」。真正被提速的是测算，能跑外会谈判的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助遮挡评估
政策匹配提速
客户画像推荐
跟进提醒加速
ai_s2_auto: 发电模拟自动算
方案配置自动出
报价单自动生成
回本年限自动给
ai_s3_list: 上门信任：业主信谁靠人。
现场勘测：能不能装靠人。
谈判签约：话怎么讲靠人。
安装跟进：落地靠人。
异议处理：犹豫怎么解靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的测算区——前期算数和配置被加速，但上门与谈判还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于被替：被替代的是「算数、出配置」的动作，不是「建信任、促签约」的岗位。能跑外会谈判的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会念报价的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 相关大专打底，在校多学光伏和政策。AI 时代纯测算在缩，早点练沟通和勘测。
从「念报价」升级成「建信任 + 跟落地」，学模拟工具，争取当区域经理。
突出真实单量和勘测经验，写清跟过哪些地区。雇主看重能跑和能签。
选人别只看嘴皮，要看勘测准不准。能落地的，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 模拟工具提效，测算缩。
分布式光伏需求增。
会跑外促签约的更抢手。

body: 光伏销售代表与评估员上门勘测屋顶朝向与遮挡，测算发电量与投资回报，讲解补贴与并网政策，制定并洽谈光伏系统方案，推动签约与安装落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 线上工具能秒算发电和回本，但这户信不信、屋顶能不能装、话怎么讲到签，还是代表定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can recite an entire city's history, but only a guide will tell an overheated traveler, 'Let's get into the shade first. I'll take care of this.'
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 55,800 tour and travel guides were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 60,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,500 jobs, with approximately 13,000 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $36,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace guides, but it will take over informational narration. Audio guides, AI tours, and voice assistants already explain attractions professionally, so travelers increasingly do not need guides who merely memorize scripts. Organizing groups, handling emergencies, communicating with warmth, and providing customized service remain human strengths.
ai_s2_accel: AI real-time translation supports international groups
Visitor-flow forecasts and recommendations for avoiding peak periods
Smart intercoms and location tracking prevent separation
Rapid generation of customized itineraries from preferences
ai_s2_auto: One-click generation of itineraries and attraction information
AI tours and voice narration replace basic interpretation
Automated ticket booking and itinerary confirmation
Automated aggregation and analysis of traveler feedback and reviews
ai_s3_list: On-site group control: Presence and authority keep a group of forty moving, dispersed appropriately, and reunited on time.
Emergency response: Lost documents, traveler illness, and sudden weather changes require a plan within seconds.
Human-centered interpretation: Turning facts into stories that resonate emotionally remains beyond AI.
Reading people: Guides quickly notice who can no longer walk and who is becoming impatient.
Local resource network: Trusted restaurants, drivers, and rescue contacts develop over years.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means that information, planning, and ticketing account for a substantial share of the work, and AI tour and booking tools are taking them over quickly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI devalues memorized scripts while shifting value toward on-site service. Guides who lead groups, handle emergencies, and provide warmth become more valuable, while script-only tours are disappearing.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter the field, first earn a tour guide qualification and build foreign-language, historical, and cultural knowledge. In the AI era, do more than memorize scripts. Practice speaking and emergency response and gain on-site experience across routes. That becomes your moat.

Use AI as a research assistant for itineraries, narration, and custom proposals, then invest the saved time in group details and reputation. Move toward educational travel, inbound tourism, and high-end customization to avoid competition in low-price tours.

Experience in interpretation, education, or service is an advantage. Begin with local reception or attraction interpretation. On your resume, write specific achievements such as independently leading a group of XX people or handling an XX emergency. This is more useful than simply saying you love travel.

Do not recruit guides solely by credentials and memorization. A simulated emergency reveals capability most clearly. People who control groups, handle emergencies, and lead custom tours deserve above-market pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid route generation by budget and preference
Prevents separation and sends meeting reminders
One-click booking of admission and lodging

ai_s7_trends: AI tours spread, devaluing basic narration and shifting guides toward on-site service + cultural experiences.
Educational travel, inbound tourism, and premium custom tours grow, increasing scarcity of guides who speak foreign languages, understand culture, and handle emergencies.
Low-price shopping tours continue to exit the market, making service quality and reputation central criteria for assignments.

body: Tour guides and escorts provide itinerary interpretation, sightseeing organization, ticketing, lodging, and dining coordination for travelers. During travel, they carry responsibilities for cultural communication, safety management, and emergency response.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能背出整座城市的历史，但游客中暑时那句「先到阴凉处，我来想办法」，只有导游会说。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年导游与陪同人员在岗约 5.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.03 万人，净增约 0.45 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代导游，但会抢走「资料讲解」的活。讲解器、AI 导览、语音助手已经能把景点讲得很专业，游客越来越不需要「背词型导游」。剩下的带团组织、应急处理、人情味沟通和定制化服务，是人的主场。
ai_s2_accel: AI 实时翻译辅助接待外宾团
客流预测与错峰安排建议
智能对讲与定位防走失
定制游行程按偏好快速生成
ai_s2_auto: 行程规划与景点资料一键生成
AI 导览与语音讲解替代基础解说
票务预订与行程确认自动化
游客反馈与点评的自动汇总分析
ai_s3_list: 现场控团：四十个人的队伍怎么带得动、散得开、聚得齐，靠的是气场。
应急处理：证件丢失、游客生病、天气突变，几秒内要给出方案。
人情味讲解：把资料变成故事，把故事讲进人心里，AI 做不到。
看眼色服务：谁走不动了、谁不耐烦了，一眼能读出来。
本地资源网络：熟门熟路的餐厅、司机、救援，是长期攒下来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的资料、规划、票务比重不小，这些正被 AI 导览和预订工具快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让「背词」贬值，反而把价值推向了现场服务——会带团、能应急、有温度的导游越来越值钱，纯靠讲解词吃饭的团正在被淘汰。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行先把导游资格证考下来，外语和历史文化底子多攒。AI 时代别只背词，练表达、练应急、多跑线路积累「现场经验」，这才是护城河。
把 AI 当资料助手：行程、讲解词、定制方案都用起来，省下时间打磨带团细节和口碑。往研学导师、入境游、高端定制方向走，避开低价团内卷。
有讲解、教育、服务背景是加分项。从地接或景区讲解做起，简历里多写「独立带过XX人团、处理过XX突发」这类具体事，比一句热爱旅游有用。
招导游别只看证和背书，模拟一场突发处置最能看出成色。会控场、懂应急、能带定制团的人，值得高于市场价的薪资。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 按预算与偏好快速生成线路

ai_s7_trends: AI 导览普及，基础讲解贬值，导游转向「现场服务 + 文化体验」价值。
研学游、入境游与高端定制增长，会外语、懂文化、能应急的导游更稀缺。
低价购物团持续出清，服务质量与口碑成为接团核心指标。

body: 导游与陪同人员负责为游客提供行程讲解、游览组织、票务与食宿协调等服务，在旅游过程中承担文化传播、安全管理和应急处置的职责。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能背出整座城市的历史，但游客中暑时那句「先到阴凉处，我来想办法」，只有导游会说。
